kind: Actual remote Supabase API integration tests, separate authenticated clients; not browser or physical-device tests

results.name: Worker and employer authenticate against real Supabase
All 8 tables deny unauthenticated data access
Worker sees only own worker record
Other worker private records are filtered by RLS
Worker and employer cross-organization reads are denied
Role promotion, wage tampering, and forged shift inserts are denied
Server-timed check-in/out, duplicate prevention, and pay calculation match
Worker report is visible in separate employer Auth session
Cross-worker reporting and worker self-resolution are denied
Employer resolution and audit metadata reach the worker
Skill records persist and edit; false verification is rejected
Feedback author privacy, 3-contributor suppression, and summary authorization hold
Records persist in a newly authenticated client session
